correctness.rationale: Direct PL orbit-coordinate equivalence and sum-free triangle bijection, complete exhaustion n=3 through 21 with two independent predicates, exact integer Smith forms, and an independent orientability obstruction verify the full claim. At n=21 the f-vector is (9,27,18), surface criteria hold, and Smith d2 has one factor two; no other torsion occurs below n=21.

value.rationale: The first nonzero torsion is a motivated and natural exact invariant of a classical equivariant topological family. The sharp minimal graph order and unexpected closed nonorientable surface reveal substantive fixed-point topology, and the additive model and complete reproducible finite proof allow further work beyond a raw table.
